dashboard.title: Allon Sarrafawa
dashboard.sub: Lafiyar dandamali, ƙidayoyin sarrafawa da ayyukan bincike na kwanan nan a duk fannoni huɗu.
dashboard.noServices: Babu ayyukan da aka yi rajista.
dashboard.unreachableNote: Ba a isa = ba a fara sabis a wannan yanayin ci gaba ba; ra'ayoyin da suka dogara suna komawa ga shuke-shuken dev da aka yiwa alama.

applications.title: Aikace-aikace
applications.sub: Rajistar ayyuka: duk ayyuka 15 na asali tare da aikace-aikacen fanni. Kunna/bice yana sarrafa ƙidayar lafiya da cancanta ta hanya.

rulePacks.title: Kunshin Ka'idoji
rulePacks.sub: Duk kunshin rp-* daga rajistar kunshin ka'idoji: matsayi, asali, sa hannu, bikin bugawa da faɗakarwar masu amfani da tsofaffi.
rulePacks.staleConsumers: Masu amfani da tsofaffi da aka makala ga tsoffin sigogi: {{list}}
rulePacks.publishConfirm: Buga {{id}}@{{ver}}? Wannan aikin biki ne da hukumar kwamiti ta ƙyale (nrs.rulepacks.published.v1).
rulePacks.publishFailed: Bugawa ta gaza (ana buƙatar matsayin kwamiti)

gates.title: Kofofi & Sa'idon Ka'ida
gates.sub: Kofofin tsari su ne canje-canje da hukumar kwamiti ke ƙyalewa. Ana yin jujjuyawa da ƙarfi, tabbatacce kuma a bincike. Sa'idon jarida yana bin kayan aikin da ke bayan kowace ƙofa.
gates.flipWarn: Jujjuyar ƙofa na da ƙyalewar kwamiti kuma ana rubuta ta a tarihin bincike marar canzawa. Kana gab da {{action}} <1>{{id}}</1>.
gates.reasonLabel: Dalili (an rubuta shi a tarihin bincike)
gates.reasonPlaceholder: misali Jarida 2025-Lam-42 ta tabbatar da CTCs
gates.flipFailed: Jujjuyawa ta gaza (ana buƙatar matsayin kwamiti)

ledger.title: Lissafi
ledger.sub: Tsarin shigarwa biyu na TigerBeetle (kobo na cikakken lamba kawai). Binciken asusu, neman ma'auni, fara canja wuri da karyayyun daidaituwar PSSP.
ledger.modalTitle: Fara canja wuri (ana jira / matakai biyu)
ledger.transferNote: Yana ƙirƙirar canja wuri na jira (ƙyalewa). Aika ko soke ta hanyar sabis na lissafi; asusu na float suna tilasta DEBITS_MUST_NOT_EXCEED_CREDITS.
ledger.pendingCreated: An ƙirƙiri canja wuri na jira {{id}} — aika ko soke shi daga sabis na lissafi (code 1=ƙyalewa).

workflows.title: Tsarin Aiki
workflows.sub: Rajistar wf-* a duk fannoni. Ana gudanar da abubuwan farawa ta temporal-sdkx; idan ba a saita TEMPORAL_URL ba, mai gudanarwa na dev yana aiwatar da su kuma ana binciken su.
workflows.inputHint: Abu JSON mai inganci da aka mika wa gudun tsarin aiki.
workflows.invalidJson: Shigarwa dole ta zama JSON mai inganci.

audit.title: Bincike & Shaida (WORM)
audit.sub: Tarihin bincike marar canzawa, abubuwan shaida na rubuta-sau-ɗaya-karanta-sau-daya tare da tantance sha256 a cikin mai bincike (WebCrypto), da hade tarihin binciken fasaha.
audit.tatSummary: Wa ya ga me, yaushe, a ƙarƙashin wanne kunshin ka'ida — shigarwa {{count}}
audit.hashOk: hash ya dace — an tabbatar da mutunci
audit.hashFail: HASH BAI DACE BA — kar a amince da wannan abu

tenants.title: Masu Haya & Shaida
tenants.sub: Matakan warewar masu haya (enclave / schema / row), masu amfani da kwamfyuta & matsayi, da dangantakar Permify.
tenants.name: Suna
tenants.isolationRow: row — schema ta raba, bambancewar tenant_id
tenants.isolationSchema: schema — schema na musamman ga kowane mai haya

flows.title: Magudanan Ketare-Yanki
flows.sub: Jadawalin F1–F10 daga gine-ginen haɗe. Duk zirga-zirgar ketare-yanki tana wucewa ta ƙofar enclave da aka bincike tare da rasit ɗin WORM na daidaitawa; F9/F10 an hana su gaba ɗaya.
flows.forbiddenTitle: Sa'idon magudanan da aka hana (F9 / F10)
flows.forbiddenClean: Tsafta — babu ganowa. Wannan mai sa'ido dole ya kasance fanko koyaushe; duk ganowa lamarin tsaro ne.
flows.receiptTitle: Rajistar rasit (saƙonnin ketare-yanki da aka bincike)

settings.title: Saituna
settings.sub: Manufofin gefe & yanayin WAF, masu bayar da sanarwa, tutocin fasali da maɓallan API.
settings.wafFailed: Canjin yanayin WAF ya gaza (ana buƙatar matsayin admin)
settings.notifNote: Duk masu bayarwa suna gudana a bayan musada tare da masu kwaikwayi a dev (alama ta gaskiya: babu SMS/imel na gaskiya da aka aika).
settings.keyPlaceholder: sunan maɓalli misali ci ceremony bot
settings.secretNote: — ana nuna shi sau ɗaya, ajiye shi yanzu.

login.devNote: Yanayin dev — admin da aka shuka
